summary: IPv4 baseline: single subscribe request/response, IPv4 single-flow
Extranonce subscription: subscribe + mining.extranonce.subscribe
Authorize: subscribe + mining.authorize with success response
Authorize reject: mining.authorize with error[24] Unauthorized
Notify job: set_difficulty + notify (clean=false, 9-element full line)
Notify clean jobs: notify with clean_jobs=true variant
Set difficulty: 16384, minimum response line 36B carried here
Difficulty update: 16384→32768, each difficulty applied to following job
Extranonce rotation: set_extranonce(b3f10a44, 8) + submit 16hex en2
Submit accept: full mining flow, submit with result=true
Submit reject: submit with result=false + error[21] Job not found
ID correlation: arbitrary id sequence 100/101/102, paired by value
Prevhash byte order: wire=byte-reversed(display), util.reverse_hash semantics
Client.get_version: pool initiates reverse request, miner auto-responds
Client.show_message: pool notification, id=null, no miner response
BIP310 mining.configure: version-rolling + mask intersection, before subscribe
BIP310 set_version_mask: mask push 00003000, id=null, immediate effect
Submit with version_bits: 6-param submit, 18000000 ⊆ 1fffe000 mask
Empty merkle: notify with merkle_branch=[], clean=true, 320B line
Extranonce2 size 8: subscribe declares size=8, submit 16hex en2
Line packing: set_difficulty+notify merged into 449B one segment (2 LF)
MSS large coinb1: coinb1 1444hex = 1717B, crosses MSS into 2 segments
IPv6: 2001:db8::75 → 2001:db8::100:75, IPv6 fixtures, offset 74
Multi-session: two sequential sessions, session 2 packet 16, distinct en1
Mining lifecycle: 11-line sequence, subscribe→authorize→2x(notify+submit)
Concurrent sessions: three miners interleaved (A/B/C), concurrent=true
RST pool kick: normal mining flow then RST (tcp.flags.reset, no FIN)
Reconnect resubscribe: session1 close, session2 reconnect with new en1
Non-default port 4444: stratum lines identical to baseline (port not in wire)
Negative: invalid JSON (truncated/malformed), rejected at validator
Negative: missing LF / CRLF / length prefix framing, rejected
notes: Last line missing LF (bare ending) or CRLF or length prefix

summary: Negative: unknown method or direction violation, rejected
notes: Unknown method mining.get_transactions or miner sends pool method

summary: Negative: wrong params count/types (e.g. subscribe empty array), rejected
notes: subscribe params empty array or notify 8 elements missing clean_jobs

summary: Negative: invalid hex (odd length / 0x prefix / non-hex char), rejected
notes: prevhash 62 hex (must be 64) or nonce contains 'g' or 0x prefix

summary: Negative: state machine violation (e.g. authorize before subscribe), rejected
notes: First event is authorize (subscribe must come first) or submit without authorize

summary: Negative: id mismatch or pseudo-id or unfinished transaction id reuse, rejected
notes: subscribe(id=1) without response, authorize reuses id=1

summary: Negative: submit job not from session or username mismatch, rejected
notes: submit job_id=999 not from any notify in session, or wrong username

summary: Negative: carrier mismatch (missing tcp / UDP / port contradiction), rejected
notes: Direct stratum layer without tcp carrier, or UDP, or port mismatch

summary: Negative: mixed address family (IPv6 on IPv4 chain), rejected
notes: IPv6 src/dst addresses paired with IPv4 layer chain

summary: Negative: validator error swallowed / completed/0 packets, rejected
notes: Validator returns completed/0 packets instead of propagating error
